display_information.name: Company Score Lookup
display_information.description: Search 250M+ company records. Revenue, employees, credit score.
display_information.long_description:
Look up any company from Slack. Search by name, VAT number, or keyword across 250+ million company records spanning 50+ countries.

Data includes: Revenue, employees, credit score, NACE codes, legal form, VAT numbers, founding date, contacts.

Free to use. No API key required for basic lookups.
